posts.name: AceSin
posts.cooked:
So "Misplaced Memo" makes the non-hero target with the lowest HP immune to damage.

Playing on "Insula Primalus" and got 3 dinosaurs all at 5 HP. Does that mean all 3 of them are immune?
posts.raw:
So "Misplaced Memo" makes the non-hero target with the lowest HP immune to damage.

Playing on "Insula Primalus" and got 3 dinosaurs all at 5 HP. Does that mean all 3 of them are immune?

posts.name: Ronway
posts.cooked: No, you chose which one would be the lowest out of that group, so you could technically hit any of the three. Unless you outright kill it, the one you would chose would now have to be the lowest. You would continue this until this is only one left.
posts.raw: No, you chose which one would be the lowest out of that group, so you could technically hit any of the three. Unless you outright kill it, the one you would chose would now have to be the lowest. You would continue this until this is only one left.

posts.name: Krayden006
posts.cooked: If the target is destroyed or removed from the game some other way, does misplaced memo then choose another target or is it destroyed too?
posts.raw: If the target is destroyed or removed from the game some other way, does misplaced memo then choose another target or is it destroyed too?

posts.name: Ronway
posts.cooked: Misplaced Memo is constantly changing. If the lowest is somehow removed from play, the new lowest will be immune. If a target enters play that is lower than the previous lowest target, the new target is the only that is immune to damage.
posts.raw: Misplaced Memo is constantly changing. If the lowest is somehow removed from play, the new lowest will be immune. If a target enters play that is lower than the previous lowest target, the new target is the only that is immune to damage.
